messages:
Nora (Product): Need a concise decision for the enterprise audit pilot: do we ship full retention for safety/auth events and deterministic sampling for traces? Customers press for "full by default" but cost is real.
Ethan (Security): Security stance: full for auth/keystore/policy-change; deterministic hash-seed sampling for request traces is acceptable if we provide reproducible proof and an auditable manifest.
Pri (Eng-Infra): Tech note: sampling with hash(request_id,seed) % 100 < pct gives determinism. We'll add tenant.audit_policy and sampling_seed per-day. Indexing on request_id is required to make exports fast. Estimate 2 sprints.
Lina (Solutions): Sales/Customers want: signed export bundles, BYOK wrapping of export keys, and a demo showing key rotation continuity.
Karl (Legal): SOC2 auditors accept sampled evidence if documented. I'll draft pilot terms: default 90-day retention, paid long-term archive, deterministic sampling disclosure, export SLA, and key-rotation notification window.
TaskBot: Created TASK-88901: "audit-export-pilot-spec" assigned to @Pri.
Ethan (Security): Manifest should include manifest_version, time_window, sampling_seed, wrapped_export_key, file_checksums, and platform_signature. Recommend ED25519 for signatures, AES-256-GCM for envelopes.
Nora (Product): Proposed pilot acceptance: 1) tenant policy API + Console UI; 2) signed export bundle + verifier guide; 3) BYOK export flow + rotation handling; 4) retention lanes (30/90/365) exposed; 5) pilot with 2 regulated customers + auditor walkthrough.
Pri (Eng-Infra): Draft manifest example (compact): manifest_version:1 tenant:acme time_window:2026-08-01/2026-08-02 sampling_seed:seed-20260801 audit_policy:auth:full,trace:5% wrapped_key:base64(...) files:[trace-20260801.ndjson.gz] checksums:[sha256:...] signature:ed25519:...
Lina (Solutions): I'll prepare onboarding/demo and the verification guide.
Karl (Legal): I'll prepare the contract addendum and sampling wording.
Nora (Product): Action items logged. Sync Friday to finalize scope. If anything blocks, tag me here.
